## Claim — `domain:devx @ objectstack` seat

`Claim:` session `af22b339-91b5-5814-8b9b-2453fc5b3f68` · branch `claude/issue-12246-collapse-hint-mid-segment-glob` · worktree `../objectstack-12246` · model tier **opus**.

**Declared file surface:** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` — `collapseHint` and its `--self-test`. Nothing else.

**Clause ②:** no. A derivation-internal string transform; no shipped accept/reject door moves.

**Unblocked by:** PR #12247, merged `0b478e1eff`. It was the open claimant on this file.

### Premise re-verified on the merged ref, not inherited

`collapseHint` is unchanged by #12247 and still reads:

```js
export function collapseHint(hint) {
  return hint.replace(/\*\*?/g, '').replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
}
```

Run against the merged tree:

| hint | collapses to | |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/*/references/_index.md` | `skills//references/_index.md` | ⛔ reaches nothing |
| `a/*/b/*/c.ts` | `a//b//c.ts` | ⛔ compounds per segment |
| `packages/**` | `packages` | ✅ correct |
| `scripts/**` | `scripts` | ✅ correct |

`git ls-files 'skills/*/references/_index.md'` → **9**. So the hint names nine tracked files and reaches none, exactly as filed.

⭐ **Why this survived: the trailing case is correct.** Both trailing strips are anchored (`/\/+$/`, `/\/$/`), so they clean up `packages/**` → `packages` but cannot touch a double slash left mid-string. Every hint in the tree that anyone happened to check was a trailing glob.

### Serial constraint — three cards still held behind this file

**#12074**, **#11556**, **#11199** all name `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and stay in this lane's serial queue until this PR lands. ⛔ Not in this card's surface.

### PM error (19): I fenced out the only surface that can fix this card

My dispatch declared the surface as **`collapseHint` and its self-test**, and put `hintCovers` out of scope. The card's own body names the remedy as *"teach `collapseHint`/`hintCovers` a mid-segment `*`"* — **I narrowed it to the half that cannot work.**

The dev did not argue that; it **showed it as a check**:
